'''Vensensor sector''' was a spatial [[Sector/Legends|sector]] represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Veedaaz Awmetth/Legends|Veedaaz Awmetth]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DB" /> [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]],<ref name="RV" /> [[Calonica]], [[Goratak III]], [[Pendari]], [[Tar Morden]].<ref name="EAOC" />
